items.summary: ProstT5 GPU inference (--gpu 1) not enabled on ROCm: top-level CMakeLists sets GGML_CUDA from ENABLE_CUDA but never GGML_HIP from USE_HIP, so createdb --prostt5-model --gpu 1 silently falls back to CPU. ggml ships a vendored GGML_HIP backend (lib/prostt5/ggml/src/ggml-hip); a follow-up could wire USE_HIP->GGML_HIP and validate (needs rocBLAS/hipBLAS + weights, egress-bound). Structure-search GPU path IS delivered.
